Officer's narrative
Officer's narrative. On arrival at the intersection in Katy, Texas, I observed a side-impact collision between two
passenger vehicles. Driver 1 was operating a sedan that had entered the intersection on a green signal when Driver
2, traveling from the cross street, struck the driver's side of the sedan. Driver 1 reported pain and swelling to the right
wrist, consistent with bracing against the door or steering wheel during the impact, and was transported for
evaluation. A Passenger was also present in the sedan but I was unable to establish with certainty which seat that
person occupied at the moment of impact, as statements varied during the scene interview. Driver 2 stated the
collision occurred as Driver 1 described, and two independent witnesses in nearby vehicles gave matching accounts.
Scene photographs show intrusion and crush damage to the driver's side consistent with the reported angle of
impact. Department records also show prior damage to the same area of Driver 1's vehicle from an earlier incident
that was never reported to this office. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle.
</page>
